verdict.rationale: Luma's Agents API documents a versioning scheme: every response carries an `X-API-Version` header and the base URL is versioned (/v1). It also states a deprecation policy: breaking changes ship behind a new version, and the previous one stays available during a deprecation window. The legacy-model migration guide adds deprecation notices with retirement dates, during which legacy requests keep working. Missing for 10: a defined deprecation-window length, a changelog page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the policy in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Breaking changes ship behind a new `X-API-Version` value; the previous version remains available during a deprecation window.
If you received a deprecation notice, use the retirement date in that message as the cutoff for your account. Legacy requests will continue to work during the notice period.
